nonsplit_general.step1_general_form: Any smooth (1,0)-form eta on the principal T^2-bundle decomposes fiberwise; the T^2-action is holomorphic so the averaging operator Av commutes with dbar and fixes V. A holomorphic retraction would give dbar-closed eta with eta(V)=1; then Av(eta) is T^2-invariant, dbar-closed, still with (Av eta)(V)=1.
nonsplit_general.step2_invariant_classification: T^2-invariant smooth (1,0)-forms are exactly c theta + pi^*beta with c in C constant (invariant functions are pullbacks) and beta a smooth (1,0)-form on tilde S.
nonsplit_general.step3_f_constant: dbar eta = dbar f wedge theta + f pi^*omega_C + pi^* dbar beta with omega_C = omega_1 + i omega_2; contracting with vertical (1,0) field V (theta(V)=1, i_V pi^*(.)=0, i_V dbar f=0 as V is type (1,0)): i_V dbar eta = -dbar f. Hence dbar eta=0 => dbar f=0 => f = c constant (compact X).
nonsplit_general.step4_cohomology: Then c pi^*omega_C + pi^* dbar beta = 0. If c=0, eta = pi^*beta has eta(V)=0 != 1, impossible. If c != 0, normalize c=1: dbar beta = -omega_C on tilde S, so [omega_C]=0 in H^{1,1}(tilde S). But [omega_j]=e_j != 0 integral with e_j^2 <= -2 (H^2(K3) even, pullback preserves square), contradiction.
nonsplit_general.step5_leray: Equivalently via Leray: R^0 pi_*O_X = O_S, R^1 pi_*O_X = O_S^{2}, R^2 pi_*O_X = O_S; since H^0(tilde S, Omega_S)=0 (K3), H^1(X, pi^*Omega_S) ~= H^1(tilde S, Omega_S), under which the extension class maps to [omega_C] != 0. Hence the extension is nonsplit.
nonsplit_general.conclusion: No holomorphic retraction exists; extension nonsplit.

slopes_class_scope.no_HYM_verdict: In EVERY balanced class: O_X is a stable rank-1 slope-0 subbundle of T_X with equal slope; if T_X were polystable, O_X would be a direct summand (polystable property). Nonsplit => T_X not polystable => by Li-Yau/Donaldson-Uhlenbeck-Yau for balanced classes, T_X admits NO HYM Chern connection. Scope 'every balanced class' is legitimate here because it uses only c1=0 slopes + nonsplit, both class-independent. In particular no HYM tangent connection exists in the certified classes [omega_{eps,alpha}].

futaki_explicit.fields: xi_1, xi_2 = generators of the fiber T^2-action (holomorphic Killing; base K3 has h^0(T)=0 so these span H^0(X,T_X))
futaki_explicit.density: For fiber generator xi with transverse Kahler potential psi (T^2-invariant data), the stringy/balanced Futaki density is m_xi = L_xi(log||Omega||_omega) = xi(log||Omega||_omega); equivalently in the anomaly pairing, F_xi = int_X xi(f) dvol_omega with f T^2-invariant (dilaton / Bott-Chern potential). By T^2-invariance xi(f) = 0 POINTWISE, so m_xi = 0 identically.
futaki_explicit.integral: F(xi_k) = int_{tilde X} m_{xi_k} omega^3/3! = int 0 = 0, k=1,2.
futaki_explicit.conclusion: Stringy Futaki invariant vanishes identically (pointwise, hence in integral).
